entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand GPS tracker. Order number is 772-91B-445.

Okay, I can help with that. Let me just pull up that order... 772-91B-445. I see it here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not broken, I just changed my mind. It was a total impulse buy, and honestly, I just don't use it. Can I return it or not?
I understand. Thanks for clarifying. Let me quickly review the return eligibility for your order. One moment.
Alright, I've got it pulled up. I see the VeloBand was delivered 19 days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days from the delivery date for a return. So yes, you're well within the timeframe.
Good. So you're sending a return label?

Yes, absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions in the next few minutes. Just pack it back in its original box and drop it off.
Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. That usually takes about 3-5 business days to reflect on your statement.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
